headline: Hope dwindles for rescue in southwestern Japan quake as death toll climbs to 25
context: Time was running out to find survivors, as rescuers continued to work in the Kumamoto area on Japan 's southern main island of Kyushu, where the magnitude 7.1 earthquake hit Tuesday.
